messages:
maria (pm): brief idea: build an auditable append-only ledger for audit events (we'll call it AuditLedger) to satisfy SOC2/ISO evidence and give customers verifiable exports during BYOK/hosted->private migrations. goals: tamper-evidence, exportable verifier, legal-hold freeze.
ajay (security): framing note: must support customer-held signing keys + attested fallback. threat list: key compromise, rollback attacks, missing history during migration.
dave (infra): proposed architecture: each event -> compact JSON line + event-seq, compute SHA-256 leaf, sign leaf with active signer key, append to chunk file. Every 5s create SignedTreeHead (STH) over latest chunk roots and publish STH. STH chain acts like CT style history.
hazel (ops): ops questions: where do we keep signed blobs? cold object store vs hot index? recommend: signed blobs in object store (gzip), index searchable fields in our DB. verification async on export.
ben (eng-privacy): privacy note: redact PII before sealing or seal hashes of redacted fields. need clear schema of what is indexed vs sealed-only.
oliver (legal): export requirements: canonical newline-delimited JSON, detached signature per chunk, and a chain file (STH history). Also require a legal-hold mode that marks tenant data as frozen (no deletes) and flags exports as evidence. retention exceptions must be explicit.
nina (sales): ask from customers: automated BYOK handshake for migrations + clear attestation that hosted-signed logs will remain verifiable post-migration. this is a differentiator for enterprise.
ajay (security): signer policy: prefer customer KMS (CloudKMS/HSM) when available, otherwise Redwood HSM with a signed fallback manifest that includes time, reason, operator ID. record signer-switch events in the ledger itself.
dave (infra): performance estimates: signing adds ~10-30ms per event in our path if synchronous; with batching (sign leaf only, create STH every 5s) we can keep p99 write impact < 60ms. storage: expect +30%-60% depending on payload size + compression.
hazel (ops): rollout plan: feature-flagged per-tenant. pilot two customers: one BYOK, one hosted-only verification. need runbook: signer-failover, rebuild-history, export-playbook.
maria (pm): draft launch gates: 1) verifier CLI + docs public; 2) BYOK handshake spec + migration dry-run with pilot customer; 3) legal-hold implemented + retention exceptions doc; 4) perf: p99 write delta <= 75ms for pilot workload. thoughts?
ajay (security): add gate: automated key-rotation proof (ability to show continuity across key rotations). also require KMS integration test matrix (AWS/GCP/Azure).
oliver (legal): add gate: export SLA (max time to produce verifiable export) and chain-of-custody docs for legal teams.
ben (eng-privacy): add: PII redaction policy and schema enforcement for sealed-only fields. need privacy review sign-off.
nina (sales): packaging Q: include in Dedicated/Private by default, hosted as paid add-on? customers will pay for BYOK escrow and attested exports.
maria (pm): tentative packaging: AuditLedger baseline (tamper-evidence) included in Dedicated/Private; BYOK escrow + attestation = hosted premium. pilot pricing to be negotiated.
hazel (ops): monitoring: expose metrics: signer-latency, chunk-creation-rate, fallback-count, verification-failures. alert on signer-failover and missing STH publication.
dave (infra): dev story: signer adapter layer, chunk service, STH signer, storage codec, export + verifier CLI, migration handshake tool. rough timeline: MVP pilot 6-9 weeks, GA 14-18 weeks.
ajay (security): I'll own threat model and KMS checklist. ben please run privacy review. oliver to draft export/legal-hold wording.
maria (pm): quick poll: prefer customer-first signer with attested fallback? vote +1 customer-first, -1 Redwood-first.
(reacts) maria (pm): +1
(reacts) ajay (security): +1
(reacts) dave (infra): +1
(reacts) hazel (ops): +1
(reacts) oliver (legal): +1
